definition: A biopesticide is a pest-control agent based on a living organism, a naturally derived substance, or a pesticidal substance produced by a plant, subject to how the term is defined by the regulator.
entry_text: A biopesticide is a pest-control agent based on a living organism, a naturally derived substance, or a pesticidal substance produced by a plant, subject to how the term is defined by the regulator.
example: A grower checks whether a registered insect-control product is classified as a biopesticide.
label: Biopesticide
